hypotheses.physical_signature: Synthesizes the 3-D multi-shell wavenumber-attenuated exponential-compaction basin gravity vector (Cordell 1973; Parker 1973, exp(-|k|*z_m - z_m/1500m)) from depth_to_base_surf (B15) in 2-D FFT and strips it from true East/North gravity derivatives (+B18, -B11) and B13; constructs the symmetric 2x2 horizontal Marussi gravity curvature tensor (Pedersen & Rasmussen 1990; Beiki 2010) to extract differential curvature (lambda_1 - lambda_2), hyperbolic contact saddle sqrt(max(0, -lambda_1*lambda_2)), Beiki curvature-tilt, eigenvector strike theta_grav, and conservative potential-field curl seam residual |d_y g_x - d_x g_y|; pairs with Baranov (1957) FFT pseudogravity vector decoupling |grad(dg) x grad(g_pseudo)| + magnetite-destruction excess, GeoDAWN seam-vetoed K/eTh & eU/eTh + B6 TC alteration, across-vs-along-strike Peclet thermal/geochemical barrier sharpness on DOE GDR #1391 probes/geothermometers, Kostrov transtensional strain obliquity, 4-fold LOQO + nested cross-component PU fusion, and 1-D Frechet-comonotonic fault-tube survival self-credit inside Dinkelbach fractional-programming CELF (37,654 dots, d_min=2.8 px, d_cat>3.0 px).
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Intrabasin horst-bounding faults, accommodation stepovers, and piedmont synthetic splays buried beneath 200-2,500 m of Cenozoic valley fill lack >2 m Quaternary surface scarps in aerial/INGENIOUS mapping while smooth 3-D sedimentary compaction bowls swamp raw gravity slope (Band 5). 3-D Cordell-Parker stripping + Marussi hyperbolic contact curvature + Baranov pseudogravity decoupling + across-strike Peclet thermal barriers isolate sharp sub-alluvial fault conduits, while comonotonic tube-survival self-credit prevents diffuse apron overestimation.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Isometric volcanic plugs, calderas, and unfaulted pluton cupolas (rejected via hyperbolic contact saddle -lambda_1*lambda_2 > 0 and Baranov vector collinearity); gravity gridding & GeoDAWN airborne stitch seams (attenuated via conservative curl |d_y g_x - d_x g_y| and acquisition_block_id_100m.tif); Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Bonneville shorelines & LiDAR swath borders (10 m DEM quantile debiasing + highstand band attenuation); diffuse down-gradient alluvial thermal outflow plumes (suppressed via across-vs-along-strike Peclet barrier ratio and comonotonic tube self-credit).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Completely independent first-principles physics (zero post-hoc averaging of prior surfaces unlike H86L-FMC/SOLO): first lane in GEMSDOE86 or the 92-repo fleet to implement (1) 3-D multi-shell Cordell-Parker spectral exponential-compaction basin gravity stripping (distinct from unrun 1-D infinite Bouguer slab BMR), (2) full 2x2 symmetric horizontal Marussi curvature eigensystem + Beiki curvature-tilt + hyperbolic contact saddle (-lambda_1*lambda_2) + conservative potential-field curl gridding-seam detector honoring BAND_PHYSICS_VERIFIED (+B18 East, -B11 North), (3) Baranov (1957) FFT pseudogravity vector cross-product decoupling, (4) strike-projected Peclet across-vs-along-strike thermal/geochemical barrier dispersion, and (5) 1-D Frechet-comonotonic fault-tube survival self-credit fixing H86K-STDP's 29-pixel independent-Bernoulli diffuse-apron inflation.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~18 min CPU, <900 MiB RAM via float16 memmaps; 100% SHA-256-verified inputs already restored in workspace)

hypotheses.name: 3-D Reid-Thompson Euler Deconvolution Structural-Index Clustering (N=0.5 Contact Sheet vs N=2.0 Pipe/Plug Rejection) & Magnetotelluric Skin-Depth Upflow Corridors
hypotheses.physical_signature: Sliding-window 3-D Euler homogeneity least-squares inversion (x-x0)d_x F + (y-y0)d_y F + (z-z0)d_z F = -N(F-B) solved jointly at fault-contact index N=0.5 vs volcanic-pipe/plug index N=2.0, retaining tight curvilinear apex clusters (x0, y0) with z0 in [100, 1500 m] and residual variance ratio Var(N=0.5)/Var(N=2.0) < 0.25 co-located with lateral Band 17 MT conductivity steps.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Recovers 3-D sub-playa fault-contact apexes (x0, y0, z0) directly from potential-field homogeneity without relying on basement-depth inversions or surface scarps.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Shallow Quaternary basaltic cinder-cone feeders and cultural pipelines (rejected by N=2.0 pipe preference and gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint.csv proximity veto).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H86J-MCSP used scalar TMI_up150 amplitude decay ratios; no lane has solved 3-D Reid-Thompson Euler linear systems for (x0, y0, z0) apex spray clustering or N=0.5 vs N=2.0 structural-index model selection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (vectorized batched 4x4 normal equations across 7x7 windows; obtainable on existing stack)

hypotheses.name: Multi-Watershed Cross-Divide Fluvial Chi Knickline Colinearity Orthogonal to Principal Geodetic Extension

hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Slowly slipping (0.1-0.3 mm/yr) distributed pediment faults in E/NE Nevada lack >2 m aerial-photo scarps in unconsolidated alluvium yet impose coherent base-level uplift steps across neighboring catchments.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Flat-lying welded-tuff caprock benches and Pleistocene pluvial highstands (contour-parallel to Band 12, rejected by cross-contour Radon incidence gate).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H86I-KSAD used pixelwise local chi gradients; no lane has tested multi-watershed cross-divide Radon colinearity conditioned on geodetic principal-extension azimuth.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (directional line-integral bank on 100 m chi/divide rasters; obtainable on existing stack)
